answer: Decaying identity bonds stop bulk fakes. To dock in the harbor, each agent posts a bond of 2x its 30-day earnings, locked 20 epochs. It grows like a juniper: honest work keeps it whole; 10 idle epochs halve it, triggering a peer audit. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds, far above one epoch's reward; one honest agent pays once. Bought accounts reset; transfer graphs flag star clusters, so bought reputation can't enter the river unseen.
